purpose: A complete, non-extrapolating reconciliation ledger for the 148 frozen VB5/VB6 rows. Every frozen id appears once and only once below. A disposition is evidence accounting, not a claim that arbitrary applications or OCXs are styled.

dispositions.meaning: A real sample and/or the self-owned dual-width runtime fixture establishes the exact runtime-owned HWND, DC, or standard-menu route. The cited S evidence defines the limited variant coverage; owner-draw, private runtime state, and unobserved variants remain outside the claim.

groups.boundary: Exact ThunderRT5/ThunderRT6 selection/button public state and image routes only.
Exact public window and message routes only; rich text, owner-draw, and unobserved list variants are not included.
Exact Frame HWND and PictureBox/Form-DC text routes only; container ownership and application drawing stay with the runtime/application.
Observed runtime-specific public owner-draw/DC paths only; file data, icons, navigation, and unobserved styles stay native.
Top-level native window and standard menu route only; this is not a claim over custom menus, MDI merge, or application-drawn content.

dispositions.meaning: The established receiver is application DC, embedded-object/data handling, nonvisual runtime work, or an unsafe host boundary. Repainting or attaching a guessed standard class would change application semantics, so preserving native behavior is the correct current disposition.

groups.boundary: Application DC content and nonvisual timer helpers; no independently attachable native control was observed.
Data, embedded object, MDI, and design-time host contracts are not safely styleable without a real host protocol.

dispositions.meaning: No implementation is admitted from a filename or a guessed class name. These rows require the listed real runtime/OCX and a public child-HWND, COM-owner, or vendor host contract before any styling work can be safely scoped.

groups.receiver: A runnable, version-correct DriveListBox sample that proves the owner-draw/DC and icon/data ownership path.
The exact registered module plus a runnable licensed sample proving its child HWND or public COM ownership and drawing contract.
A version-correct runtime and public owner/protocol evidence; a name resembling an intrinsic control is insufficient.
A vendor-owned visible host contract; only then can a host-border-only option be assessed without repainting media or grid content.

completion_check: 30 + 20 + 98 = 148. A verifier must compare the set of ids to source_matrix and reject duplicates, omissions, or unknown ids.
result: The ledger closes the accounting gap but does not close T17: it proves exactly which remaining inputs are needed for the 98 unverified rows and preserves the 20 rows for which styling would be unsafe.
